title: Study of bacteria, archaea, and viruses in anaerobic digesters
description: The genomic and viral DNA was extracted and sequenced from the anaerobically digested sludge samples in three full-scale wastewater treatment facilities in the United States. The bacterial, archaeal, and viral ecology was studied.
